title: pm-eng lantern jotter - eden
content:
Purpose: short, tactical 1:1 prep for sync with Eng Lead (focus: routing + console rollouts + Dedicated capacity).

Meeting logistics:
- Time: 30m (block reserved)
- Attendee: Eden (PM), Jordan (Eng Lead) — quick follow-ups from infra backlog
- Tone: quick decisions, unblock engineering, capture owner + due date

Top goals for this week (why this meeting matters)
- Decide routing fallback order for cross-region requests (latency vs cost tradeoff)
- Agree cutover plan for console feature flags (canary + auto-fallback)
- Remove blocker on Dedicated pool scale test (loss-of-qps on long sequences)

Agenda (30m) — prioritized
1) Quick sync (2m): any fire/new blockers?
2) Routing policy proposal (10m) — two options, need picking and rollout window
   - Option A: latency-first across preferred region -> fallback to cheaper region after 250ms
   - Option B: cost-first (prefer cheaper variant unless latency > 350ms)
   - Tradeoffs: user-visible tail latency vs unit-cost savings; impacts on SLA math and SLO alerts
   - Decision ask: pick option or defer with action to simulate 3-day traffic window
3) Console rollouts (8m)
   - Current: feature flag gate + canary (5% traffic) but no auto-fallback on model mismatch
   - Risk: if a new model regresses on safety evals, users may see bad outputs for 5% of sessions
   - Proposal: add automated evaluation check (smoke eval) during canary that will auto-fallback if regen rate > threshold
   - Decision ask: approve adding smoke eval gating and who owns integration (ENG + Product infra?)
4) Dedicated capacity scale test update (6m)
   - Issue: during long-token sequences (>2k), qps drops ~30% after mem pressure; suspected kv-cache eviction policy bug
   - Ask: greenlight pursuing localized fix vs temporary resize; need estimate for fix (engineering) + risk if we postpone until next sprint
5) Quick AOB + action items (4m)

Prep notes (things to say / watch for)
- Remind Jordan: keep rollback path simple — prefer quick config toggle over code change for initial rollout
- If Jordan pushes for Option B, ask for concrete numbers that show cost delta w/ 95th percentile latency impact; I need the math to present to product leads
- Ask ENG to wire smoke eval results to Console Alerts (traceable ticket) so CS can see and act
- For Dedicated test: capture heap profiles and which kernel path is hot; suggest pairing with Applied ML for kernel investigation

Unresolved questions to capture in doc
- What is acceptable tail latency bump for power users vs cost savings? (threshold to define in SLOs)
- Who owns the smoke eval definition (data set / metrics)? Product or Applied ML?
- If canary auto-fallback triggers twice in a week, what's the escalation flow?

Action items (explicit: owner + due)
- Jordan: run 2 simulated traffic runs comparing Option A vs Option B; include 95/99 latency, cost delta. Due: 2026-03-17.
- Eden: draft short decision memo summarizing recommended routing policy and SLO impact to share with GTM + Eng Directors. Due: 2026-03-15.
- Kai Chen: prototype smoke-eval hook that can run during canary and emit pass/fail (simple regen check). Due: 2026-03-19.
- Eng-SRE: capture heap/kernels during Dedicated long-seq test and add logs for kv-cache eviction events. Owner: Priya (SRE). Due: 2026-03-18.
- Eden + Jordan: agree rollback playbook (one-pager) for console rollouts; include exact toggles and contacts. Due: 2026-03-16.

Parking lot / later discussion
- Consider introducing cost-aware routing signal into SDK (client-side hint) — low priority
- Longer term: invest in model variants optimized for long-sequence throughput to avoid Dedicated pressure

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep the ask small: pick the routing policy now OR commit to a short simulation window. Don't let it become 2-week research.
- If Jordan asks for more data, push for a short ab test instead of full-blown modeling.
- Remember to CC CS on any canary fallback that affects user sessions.

Meeting follow-up template (post-meeting) — copy into Slack thread + Confluence
- Decisions made:
  1) Routing policy: <Option chosen>
  2) Canary smoke-eval: <yes/no>; owner: <name>
- Actions assigned: list (owner, due)
- Next check-in: date/time

Quick reference links
- Console rollout plan: https://confluence.redwood.company/console/rollout-plan
- Routing RFC draft: https://confluence.redwood.company/routing/rfc-2026
- Dedicated scale-test ticket: JIRA-RED-3412
- PR for routing config: github.com/redwood-inference/routing-config/pull/78

Tone/misc: be decisive, keep scope small, surface SLO math, push for owner + due on all asks.

End of jotter.
